title: Capitals sign Boone Jenner, former Blue Jackets captain, to 4-year, $23 million deal
content:
The Washington Capitals have signed free agent Boone Jenner to a four-year deal worth $23 million, the team announced Wednesday. The contract will carry an annual cap hit of $5.75 million.

A second-round pick to the Columbus Blue Jackets in 2011, Jenner had spent his entire 13-year NHL career with the franchise. He served as the Blue Jackets’ captain for the past five seasons.

Jenner, 32, hit unrestricted free agency on Wednesday after coming off a four-year, $15 million contract that carried a $3.75 million cap hit. He finished the 2025-26 season with 13 goals and 38 points in 67 games.

This story will be updated.
